events.title: A Look At Veolia Environnement’s Valuation After Earnings Beat And New Global Contracts
events.body: Veolia Environnement (ENXTPA:VIE) is back in focus after reporting 2025 earnings above its own guidance, along with higher EBITDA margins, a proposed dividend increase, ambitious 2026 targets, and sizable new contracts in India and the UK.

events.title: Veolia Environnement SA (VEOEF) Full Year 2025 Earnings Call Highlights: Record EBITDA Margin ...
events.body: Veolia Environnement SA (VEOEF) surpasses EBITDA growth targets, proposes increased dividends, and outlines strategic plans amidst rising debt and economic challenges.
